description: This file defines UI components for displaying category selections in a Flutter app. It includes a model for categories, a widget for the categories list, and individual category buttons with navigation functionality.

classes.name: CategoryModel
classes.description: Data model representing a category with a name, SVG icon source, and an optional route.

classes.name: Categories
classes.description: Stateless widget that renders a horizontal list of categories allowing navigation to different screens.

classes.name: CategoryBtn
classes.description: Stateless widget that displays an individual category button with visual indication for active state and tap handling.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the Categories list and individual category buttons.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Callback invoked when a category button is tapped, handles navigation if a route is specified.
